highlights: Of the 192 review leads, 7.0.18 fixes 45 completely and 37 partly; 108 are still present and 2 are not bugs. We reviewed about 70 of the 7.0.18 commits against our findings (a commit can get different verdicts for different findings); 8 of them are wrong for at least one finding (they introduce a defect). The 25 new defects we found this round (PS3-*) are mostly in code the 7.0.18 fixes touched.

The 8 wrong fixes (the eighth, 635741dd, is below): the tree-leaf loader (18911e4f) now frees malformed tleaf/ltleaf files twice and its overflow test is itself undefined behaviour; the sub-architecture loader (ecaf094e) double-frees on bad terminal numbers; SCOTCH_graphMapFixed() loops forever when there are many more parts than fixed vertices (22c9c42e); a failed thread start still hangs, now in pthread_cond_destroy, with the context freed under a running thread (86559b85); dgmap -v prints CommDelta=2 for every unweighted graph (27f4193c); dummysizes takes one-character file names for stdin/stdout (858ea2bc); non-root processes offset an uninitialised label pointer (59c9a31c). The eighth: 635741dd (parallel build with older Bison) makes a default configure with the Ninja generator fail with a dependency cycle between dummysizes and scotch.h; v7.0.17 and its parent build, Unix Makefiles accept the cycle (PS3-G29-2). Separately, 52dcf602 fixes COR-24 but makes a core number of -1 (documented as unbound) pin threads to CPU 0.

Threaded bgraphBipartGg(): unchanged since 7.0.17 (SEP-13). With SCOTCH_DETERMINISTIC=1 the pristine 7.0.18 gives several partitions over fresh runs (4 at 2 threads, 2-3 at 4 threads over 20 runs), and ThreadSanitizer shows the seeding race on every run. Our series gives one partition per thread count, the same as on 7.0.17.

The combined series (248 commits on v7.0.18: 232 from the first pass, 16 follow-ups from the independent re-check, which also fixes the Ninja failure) applies with a plain git am, builds with 0 warnings on 32- and 64-bit Gnum ASan+UBSan trees, and is checked with make check, ptcheck and escheck against the pristine 7.0.18 built the same way (qa.json).
